description: A normal home connection: cable or DSL over Wi-Fi to a server in the same region. 80 ms round trip with 15 ms of jitter, and 1 % of the packets lost in each direction.

allowances.reason: the round trip of 80 ms plus the jitter of 15 ms

notApplicable.reason: the profile loses 1 % of the packets, and owner snapshots travel unreliably, so some never arrive by design; snapshot_drops still judges whether the worker sent them all
